definitions.gloss: free time; spare time; open slot
definitions.explanation: An unoccupied period of time in one's schedule, available for other activities. Often used in the context of work, school, or appointments.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}に{勉強|べんきょう}する。
examples.english: I study during my free time.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}に{少|すこ}し{空|あ}き{時間|じかん}ができた。
examples.english: I had a little free time open up in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}と{会議|かいぎ}の{間|あいだ}の{空|あ}き{時間|じかん}を{使|つか}ってメールの{返信|へんしん}を{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: I used the free time between meetings to get through my email replies.

notes:
A compound of {空|あ}き (empty, available) and {時間|じかん} (time). Describes gaps or openings in a schedule rather than leisure time in general. Commonly used in workplace and school settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}を{使|つか}う: to use one's free time
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}ができる: to have free time open up
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}を{有効|ゆうこう}に{使|つか}う: to use free time effectively
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}に{何|なに}をする: what to do in one's free time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暇|ひま}: free time, not busy — broader, can imply boredom or having nothing to do
- {余暇|よか}: leisure — formal term for recreational time off from work
- {自由|じゆう}{時間|じかん}: free time — often used in structured settings like school trips or tours
